title: leucosceptrum stellipilum var. radicans
intro: Leucosceptrum stellipilum var. radicans, commonly known as Korean angelica tree, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in Korean medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and pain. The therapeutic actions of Leucosceptrum stellipilum var. radicans include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds are responsible for its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce oxidative stress, and inhibit the growth of pathogens.
